title: Page 10
content_zh:
原嘉宁虽然有点疑惑，但还是告别了与她同乘的瑜王妃，转登上玄渊的马车。

车子里面，玄渊一个人正襟危坐，见她过来，伸手亲自把她扶上来，然后让她与自己并肩而坐。

原嘉宁不解地看着他，问：「就要到内城了，你还急急要我赶过来，有什么事？」

玄渊微微一笑，握住她的手，说：「没事，只是觉得这是咱们正式迈入新京城的第一步，应该并肩携手而已。」

原嘉宁转头看他，他也正一脸平静地凝望着她。

她对他展颜而笑。

玄昱是个长寿的皇帝，虽然他早年的私生活荒唐无比，到了中晚年，却格外注重起修身养性，所以他驾崩的时候，太子玄渊已经四十多岁。

从十五岁被立为太子，到四十多岁才继位登基，玄渊安安稳稳做了二十多年近三十年的太子，做太子的时间甚至比一些皇帝的寿命还长。

两代帝王的交替基本上算是平稳，太子的弟弟们早没了气力再兴风作浪。虽然不想做皇帝的皇子不是好皇子，但是那也要看有没有那个实力，几乎等同被圈养的三皇子，以及被养成了纨绮浪荡子的四皇子，已经都没有能力击败这些年来低调却绝不软弱的太子，所以只能乖乖待在各自的王府里做个闲王爷。

与雄才大略但私底下却常常任性强势的玄昱相比，新任皇帝玄渊私生活就严谨得堪称天下第一，后宫里只有一个属于他的女人，那就是他的皇后原氏嘉宁。

玄渊的个性与他的父亲截然相反，大臣们私下里都说这是物极必反。

不过，玄渊的执政能力倒是继承了玄昱，作为开平盛世的皇帝，他一生所做的几项大政策，都是利国利民的善政。

而当他的儿子玄景继位以后，景国更是达到了繁华的顶峰，开创了长达百年的太平盛世。

所以，以后的史学家对玄渊这个出身奇特的皇帝，评价还是相当高，因为他的承前启后，才有了景国历史上的绚烂繁华。

他做太子时，恭顺孝敬皇上，而他做了皇帝之后，又善于教养自己的太子，而且自始至终，他身边就只有一个女人原氏嘉宁。

原嘉宁生育最后一个儿子时，年龄已经四十多岁，有些伤了身体，虽然之后玄渊为她精心调养，但是她在五十五岁时仍然撒手人寰了。

皇后殡天后，太子担心父皇伤心过度，便时刻陪伴着他，玄渊虽然有时候会发呆，但并没有表现得太过哀伤，太子也就渐渐安了心。

这样又过了三年，玄渊突然在早朝时昏倒在龙座上，然后他的身子就急剧衰弱下去。

在弥留之际，他对太子说：「你母后说朕是个好皇帝，要朕在皇位上多待几年，不肯让朕随她去，朕向来尊重她的意见，所以努力活了下来。可是这三年多漫长啊，比过去三十年还难熬，朕再也撑不下去啦，让朕走吧，想来她也不会再怪朕了吧？」

一向觉得自家父皇太过看重感情的玄景，此时早已泪流满面，泣不成声。

玄景继位后，虽然在政治上励精图治，但在私生活上却越来越像自家祖父，一生经历的女人众多，他似乎对每个美女都爱，但又始终没见有多么深爱。

其实玄景的心底害怕那种生死相随的感情，究竟要如何相爱，才能让一个人死了，另一个人就算拚命挣扎着也活不下？

从玄昱到玄渊，再从玄渊到玄景，或许，这又是另一种物极必反了。

玄渊和原嘉宁这一对彼此忠贞的皇帝夫妻终成绝响。

皇太孙玄景是被他的皇祖父玄昱亲自抚育教养大的。

平时，玄景就住在玄昱宫殿的偏殿，早晚都会被玄昱亲自教导功课。

其实就连皇子们，也没有受过玄昱这样的精心养育和教导。

只能说这爷孙俩对了脾气，彼此喜爱，所以才日夜相处也不厌烦，最主要是玄昱真心喜爱玄景。

可是与祖父相处的时间久了，与自己父母相处的时间就短了，虽然玄景每逢初一十五都会专程到东宫去向自己的父母请安，但是彼此之间的感情毕竟不如弟妹们与父母那么亲昵。

玄景其实也是有点小忧伤，但是想想鱼与熊掌不可兼得，他也就毅然抛弃了自己的这点小忧郁，继续做他积极向上、认真学习的皇太孙。

玄景八岁的时候，在御花园玩耍，追着他当时正热衷的蹴鞠跑，不知道怎么就跑到了一个阴暗的角落，然后意外听到了一个惊天大秘密——

皇太孙不是太子妃的亲生子，其实是太子妃抱养的一名大宫女的孩子，太子妃为了邀宠才对外宣称是她的儿子，太子独宠太子妃，所以就帮她瞒着众人，包括皇上，而太子妃为了怕秘密泄漏就杀了那名大宫女，那名宫女还是当今皇后赐给太子的呢，好像是叫什么琥珀的……

那两个窃窃私语的小宫女不时东张西望，一副唯恐秘密泄漏的样子，全然不知躲在花架下的皇太孙早已经脸色铁青，浑身冰冷。

八岁的孩子有多大能耐呢？就算玄景比较聪明，比较早熟，可是他依然被这晴天霹雳般的秘密给吓到了。

皇太孙病了。

他被巨大的惶恐与愤怒所席卷，可是他什么都不敢说，只能忍着，于是开始做恶梦，病情越发严重。

太子和太子妃亲自来照顾他，却被他拒之门外。

于是改由玄昱亲自照顾他，他又觉得自己不再是皇祖父的嫡长孙，也许以后皇祖父也不会喜欢他了，他会成为被人抛弃和鄙夷的小孩。

所以他决定把这个秘密藏在心底，谁也不去问，谁也不告诉，同时，他暗自决定杀人灭口──除掉那两个小宫女。

于是玄景慢慢恢复了健康，在一个月后，找到一个借口，杖毙了那两名小宫女。

他的手，从这么小就开始沾染血腥，心机越发深沉。

或许玄昱真的看得很准，玄景是天生的权谋家，天生的皇位继承人。

玄渊和原嘉宁生前，玄景都表现得很尊敬孝顺，但始终缺乏了一种为人子女的亲切热络，玄渊和原嘉宁也曾经百思不解，却始终找不到理由，也只能归结为跟随祖父生活，距离造成了感情的疏离。

直到原嘉宁去世后，到玄渊病重时，玄景才说出了这段秘辛。

他对玄渊说：「我后来派人彻查了金陵东宫里的事情，所有的人都查证了一遍，确认了自己是父皇和母后的亲生子，我只不过是中了敌人的圈套，中了离间计，那两个小宫女是故意说给我听的呢。可惜习惯使然，到了后来，我就算想与父皇母后亲近，也不知道该如何做了。」

玄渊久久看着他，最后轻轻叹了口气，说：「你果然天生就是皇家子弟。」

一个这样惊天的大秘密，只有八岁的他居然就知道了权衡利弊，知道了杀人灭口，知道了瞒天过海，知道了事后查证，而最重要的是，这件事他居然还真的就一瞒这么多年，真是天才。

可是这是多么让人不喜的天分啊。

玄渊说：「当年，你母后小时候也曾听到过流言蜚语，以为自己不是你外祖父的亲生女儿，以为自己还有个生父，你知道她怎么做的吗？她直接就跑去找你外祖父了，问自己到底是谁的孩子。」

说着说着，玄渊忍不住笑起来，又说：「你说她有多笨啊，多傻啊，把你修养绝佳的外祖父都气得失态，当场打了她一巴掌，虽然她当时哭得很委屈，事后却心底一片晴朗，没有半分阴霾。」
content_en:
Although Yuan Jianing was a little confused, she said goodbye to Princess Yu who was riding with her, and boarded Xuan Yuan's carriage.

Inside the car, Xuan Yuan was sitting upright alone. When he saw her coming, he stretched out his hand to help her up, and then asked her to sit side by side with him.

Yuan Jianing looked at him puzzled and asked, "We are about to reach the inner city, and you still want me to come here urgently. What's the matter?"

Xuan Yuan smiled slightly, held her hand and said, "It's okay, I just think this is the first step for us to officially enter the new capital, and we should join hands together."

Yuan Jianing turned to look at him, and he was staring at her calmly.

She smiled at him.

Xuan Yu was a long-lived emperor. Although his private life in his early years was extremely absurd, in his middle and later years, he paid special attention to self-cultivation. Therefore, when he died, Prince Xuan Yuan was already in his forties.

From being established as the crown prince at the age of fifteen to succeeding to the throne in his forties, Xuan Yuan has been the crown prince for more than twenty years and nearly thirty years. The period of time he has been a crown prince is even longer than the life span of some emperors.

The transition between the two generations of emperors was basically smooth, and the prince's younger brothers had long since lost the energy to make trouble again.Although a prince who does not want to be an emperor is not a good prince, it depends on his strength. The third prince, who was almost as captive, and the fourth prince, who was raised as a dandy, no longer have the ability to defeat the prince who has been low-key but not weak over the years, so they can only stay in their respective palaces and be idle princes.

Compared with Xuan Yu, who was talented but often willful and strong in private, the new emperor Xuan Yuan was the most rigorous in his private life. There was only one woman who belonged to him in the harem, and that was his empress Yuanshi Jianing.

Xuan Yuan's personality is completely opposite to that of his father. Ministers privately said that this is the opposite of everything.

However, Xuanyuan's ability to govern was inherited from Xuan Yu. As the emperor in the prosperous Kaiping era, the several major policies he made throughout his life were all good governance that benefited the country and the people.

And when his son Xuanjing succeeded to the throne, Jingguo reached the peak of prosperity and created a century-long peaceful age.

Therefore, future historians still have a very high evaluation of Xuan Yuan, an emperor with a strange background. Because of his connection with the past and the future, the splendid prosperity in Jingguo's history was achieved.

When he was the prince, he was respectful and filial to the emperor. After he became the emperor, he was good at educating his prince. From the beginning to the end, there was only one woman, Yuanshi Jianing, by his side.

When Yuan Jianing gave birth to her last son, she was already in her forties and suffered some physical injuries. Although Xuan Yuan took good care of her afterwards, she still passed away at the age of fifty-five.

After the queen's funeral, the prince was worried that his father would be too sad, so he stayed with him all the time. Although Xuan Yuan would sometimes be in a daze, he did not show too much sadness, and the prince gradually felt at ease.

After another three years of this, Xuan Yuan suddenly fainted on the dragon throne during the morning court, and then his body weakened rapidly.

When he was dying, he said to the prince: "Your mother said that I am a good emperor and wanted me to stay on the throne for a few more years. She refused to let me go with her. I have always respected her opinion, so I worked hard to survive. But these three years are so long, and they are more difficult than the past thirty years. I can't hold on any longer. Let me go. I think she won't blame me anymore, right?"

Xuanjing, who had always felt that his father valued emotions too much, was already in tears and broke down in tears.

After Xuanjing succeeded to the throne, although he worked hard politically, he became more and more like his grandfather in his private life. He experienced many women in his life. He seemed to love every beautiful woman, but he never showed how deeply he loved them.

In fact, Xuan Jing is afraid of the kind of life-and-death relationship in his heart. How can we love each other so that one person dies and the other person cannot survive even if he struggles desperately?

From Xuan Yu to Xuan Yuan, and then from Xuan Yuan to Xuan Jing, perhaps this is another kind of thing that must be reversed.

Xuan Yuan and Yuan Jianing, an emperor couple who were loyal to each other, finally got married.

The emperor's grandson Xuanjing was personally raised and educated by his emperor's grandfather Xuanyu.

Usually, Xuanjing lived in the side hall of Xuanyu's palace, and would be taught by Xuanyu himself sooner or later.

In fact, even the princes have not received such careful upbringing and instruction from Xuan Yu.

It can only be said that the grandfather and grandson have the right temperament and like each other, so they don't get tired of getting along day and night. The most important thing is that Xuan Yu really loves Xuan Jing.

However, the time spent with his grandfather became shorter than the time spent with his parents. Although Xuanjing would make a special trip to the East Palace to pay his respects to his parents every first and fifteenth day of the lunar month, the relationship between them was not as close as that between his younger siblings and their parents.

Xuan Jing was actually a little sad, but thinking that he couldn't have his cake and eat it too, he resolutely abandoned his little melancholy and continued to be the emperor's grandson who was positive and diligent in studying.

When Xuan Jing was eight years old, he was playing in the Royal Garden, chasing Cuju, which he was passionate about at the time. He somehow ended up in a dark corner, and then accidentally heard a shocking secret——

The Crown Prince was not the biological son of the Crown Princess, but actually the child of a palace maid whom the Crown Princess had adopted. The Crown Princess claimed to be her son in order to invite her favor. The Crown Prince doted on the Crown Princess alone, so he helped her hide it from everyone, including the Emperor. The Crown Princess killed the palace maid for fear that the secret would be leaked. The palace maid was given to the Prince by the current Queen, and it seemed to be called Amber...

The two little palace ladies who were whispering looked around from time to time, as if they were afraid that the secret would be leaked. They had no idea that the emperor's grandson hiding under the flower stand was already pale and cold.

How capable is an eight-year-old child?Even though Xuan Jing was smarter and more precocious, he was still frightened by this shocking secret.

The emperor's grandson is ill.

He was swept away by huge panic and anger, but he did not dare to say anything and could only endure it. Then he began to have nightmares and his condition became more and more serious.

The prince and princess personally came to take care of him, but he turned him away.

So Xuan Yu took care of him personally, and he felt that he was no longer the eldest grandson of the emperor's grandfather. Maybe the emperor's grandfather would not like him in the future, and he would become an abandoned and despised child.

So he decided to hide this secret in his heart, and no one would ask or tell anyone. At the same time, he secretly decided to kill people to silence them - to get rid of the two little palace ladies.

So Xuanjing slowly recovered, and a month later, he found an excuse and killed the two little palace ladies with a stick.

His hands were stained with blood since he was a child, and his scheming became more and more profound.

Maybe Xuan Yu really saw it correctly. Xuan Jing was a born strategist and a natural heir to the throne.

When Xuan Yuan and Yuan Jianing were alive, Xuan Jing was very respectful and filial, but he always lacked the kindness and warmth of being a child. Xuan Yuan and Yuan Jianing were also puzzled, but they could never find the reason. They could only attribute it to living with their grandfather. The distance caused emotional alienation.

It was not until after Yuan Jianing's death and when Xuan Yuan was seriously ill that Xuan Jing revealed this secret.

He said to Xuan Yuan: "Later I sent people to thoroughly investigate what happened in the East Palace of Jinling. Everyone checked and confirmed that I am the biological son of the father and the queen. I just fell into the trap of the enemy and fell into the alienation plan. The two little palace ladies deliberately told me. Unfortunately, habits dictated that later on, even if I wanted to get close to the father and queen, I didn't know how to do it."

Xuan Yuan looked at him for a long time, and finally sighed softly and said, "You are indeed born to be a child of the royal family."

For such a shocking secret, at the age of only eight, he actually knew how to weigh the pros and cons, how to kill people and silence them, how to hide it from the truth, how to conduct verification afterwards, and most importantly, he actually managed to keep it a secret for so many years. What a genius.

But this is such an unpleasant talent.

Xuan Yuan said: "Back then, your mother heard rumors when she was a child. She thought she was not your grandfather's biological daughter and thought she had a biological father. Do you know what she did? She went straight to your grandfather and asked her whose child it was."

As he spoke, Xuan Yuan couldn't help but laugh, and added: "You said how stupid and stupid she was, which made your well-educated grandfather lose his temper and slapped her on the spot. Although she cried aggrieved at the time, afterwards she felt clear in her heart, without any haze."
